provenance: User-supplied real QE ACF.dat, matching full_scf.in, and matching relaxed CIF.
chargeConvention: q = atomic number - core subtraction - ACF electrons. This ACF was obtained from reconstructed all-electron density, so the core subtraction is zero for every element.
densityTypeEvidence: The nuclear-charge total is 1432 electrons and ACF reports 1430.1339 electrons. This is consistent with reconstructed all-electron density and inconsistent with the 1000-electron valence-only total.
mappingValidation: ACF, SCF, and CIF each contain 336 atoms. SCF ATOMIC_POSITIONS order is the authoritative atom-to-element map. SCF and CIF structures agree; ACF positions use a different periodic/origin representation and are not compared by direct Cartesian subtraction.
